answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 3477 Country: United Kingdom Title: What is the difference between Tabligh Jamaat and Deobandi as many people suggest that Tabligh Jamaat and Deobandi are two different groups. Question: SALAAM, What is the difference between Tabligh Jamaat and Deobandi as many people suggest that Tabligh Jamaat and Deobandi are two different groups. Jazakallah Answer ID: 3477 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 274/260=J) Deobandiyat is a school of thought. Following the creed and beliefs of Ahl-e-Sunnah Wal-Jamat is Deobandiyat . Any group having the same beliefs is Deobandi . Tablighi Jamat is also Deoabndi whether it does not call itself Deobandi or no one calls it so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
